\par\vspace{3pt}
{\footnotesize\raggedright Probabilistic evaluation, in tonnes (lower = better). The three predictive distributions are represented by the same nine quantiles (0.1, ..., 0.9): native quantiles for Chronos, Gaussian quantiles of the one-step forecast for SARIMA and SARIMA-sel. CRPS$_Q$ = (2/9) $\sum$ quantile loss. Threshold-weighted CRPS: weight 1 when $|z/y_{t-1} - 1| > u$, with $u$ the MoM P75 threshold of the window (chaining function). The exact CRPS of the Gaussian is shown as a reference for SARIMA and SARIMA-sel. Diff. vs. SARIMA: paired 95\% bootstrap CI; DM: Diebold--Mariano with HLN correction. All results in this table are post-protocol analyses (second review round) and do not modify the pre-registered ten-model ranking.\par}
